description: The cluster at a glance: node health, requests vs allocatable vs real usage (the platform's recurring capacity problem is nodes full of memory REQUESTS while real usage is far lower), unhealthy pods with their reasons, rollouts, namespaces and quotas, storage, the control plane and the network. kube-state-metrics series are pinned to job="kube-state-metrics" because OpenCost re-exports some of them.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Ready nodes out of all nodes.

panels.title: Nodes with problems
panels.description: Nodes not Ready, cordoned, or reporting Memory/Disk/PID pressure.

targets.expr: count((sum by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", condition="Ready", status!="true"}) > 0) or (sum by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure", status="true"}) > 0) or (sum by (node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node"}) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods in phase Running.

panels.title: Pods pending
panels.description: Pods waiting to be scheduled or to start. Persistently pending pods usually lack requestable capacity (see the Capacity dashboard) or a volume.

panels.title: Pods failed / evicted
panels.description: Pods in phase Failed, including evicted ones still listed.

panels.title: Crash-looping containers
panels.description: Containers currently waiting in CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull or CreateContainerConfigError.

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description: Container restarts across the cluster in the last hour.

panels.title: OOMKilled (1h)
panels.description: Containers whose last termination was an OOMKill and which restarted in the last hour — the working set hit the memory limit.

targets.expr: count((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", reason="OOMKilled"}) == 1) and on (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: CPU requested by running and pending pods as a share of allocatable CPU. The scheduler refuses new pods once a node's requests reach 100%, whatever the real usage.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: Real CPU usage (cAdvisor) as a share of allocatable CPU.

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Memory requested by running and pending pods as a share of allocatable memory.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Real container working set as a share of allocatable memory. The gap to 'Memory requested' is memory reserved but unused.

panels.title: Pods vs capacity
panels.description: Scheduled pods as a share of the nodes' pod capacity (maxPods).

panels.title: Control plane pods ready
panels.description: Ready share of the static control-plane pods (etcd, kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler) and the cloud-controller-manager in kube-system.

panels.title: Requests vs real usage per node
Memory REQUESTED % of allocatable
panels.description: Per node. This is what the scheduler sees: a node at ~100% accepts no pod with a memory request, even when its real usage (right) is low.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Memory USED % of allocatable
panels.description: Per node: container working set (cAdvisor) against allocatable.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU REQUESTED % of allocatable
panels.description: Per node CPU requests of running and pending pods against allocatable CPU.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU USED % of allocatable
panels.description: Per node real CPU usage against allocatable.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Capacity per node: allocatable, requested and used for CPU and memory, pods, and conditions. 'Req %' columns turn amber at 85% and red at 95% — the point where the scheduler stops placing pods.

targets.expr: max by (node, kernel_version, kubelet_version, internal_ip) (kube_node_info{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

100 * sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", node=~"$node"}[5m])) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

100 * sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Memory: allocatable vs requested vs used
panels.description: Cluster totals over time. Requests (amber) are what fills nodes; usage (green) is what the workloads actually consume.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

panels.title: CPU: allocatable vs requested vs used
panels.description: Cluster totals over time.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", node=~"$node", resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

panels.title: Pods not running
panels.description: Pods in phase Pending, Failed or Unknown, with the reason a container is waiting when there is one.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1)

max by (namespace, pod) (time() - kube_pod_created{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1)

panels.title: Top restarting containers (24h)
panels.description: Containers with the most restarts in the last 24 hours and the reason of their last termination (OOMKilled = memory limit, Error = non-zero exit).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h])) > 0)
max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1)

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: Pods per phase over time.

panels.title: Waiting containers by reason
panels.description: Containers that cannot start, by reason.

panels.title: Restarts & OOM kills
panels.description: Container restarts and OOM events per interval across the cluster.

panels.title: Deployments not fully available
panels.description: Deployments whose available replicas are below the desired count, or with an update still rolling out.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 0 or max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"} - kube_deployment_status_replicas_updated{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 0

panels.title: StatefulSets not ready
panels.description: StatefulSets with fewer ready replicas than desired.

panels.title: DaemonSets & Jobs with problems
panels.description: DaemonSets with unavailable or misscheduled pods, and Jobs that failed.

panels.title: Namespaces: requests vs usage
panels.description: Per namespace: memory and CPU requested by running pods against what they actually use. Low efficiency = reserved capacity nobody uses, which is what fills nodes.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase="Running"} == 1))

100 * sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase="Running"} == 1))

sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase="Running"} == 1))

panels.title: Resource quota usage
panels.description: Used vs hard for every ResourceQuota (the environment namespaces carry one). At 100% new pods in that namespace are rejected at admission.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, resourcequota, resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", type="used"})
max by (namespace, resourcequota, resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", type="hard"})

100 * max by (namespace, resourcequota, resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", type="used"}) / (max by (namespace, resourcequota, resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"$namespace", type="hard"}) > 0)

panels.title: PVCs by phase
panels.description: PersistentVolumeClaims by phase. A Pending claim keeps its pod Pending too.

panels.title: Pending PVCs
panels.description: Claims not yet bound, with their storage class.

panels.title: Volume usage (CSI volumes)
panels.description: Used share of each volume that reports kubelet volume statistics. Node-local adhar-local volumes (the default class) report none, so most platform volumes are not listed — their services' own dashboards estimate usage instead.

panels.title: Requested storage by namespace
panels.description: Sum of PVC storage requests per namespace (top 10).

panels.title: API server requests by code
panels.description: Requests per second to kube-apiserver by response class.

panels.title: API server latency p99 by verb
panels.description: 99th percentile request latency (excluding WATCH/CONNECT). Seconds here precede leader-election failures of the controllers.

panels.title: etcd request latency p99 (from the API server)
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of the API server's etcd requests by operation. etcd itself is not scraped on kubeadm nodes (it listens on localhost).

panels.title: API server in-flight & queued
panels.description: Requests being served (mutating / read-only) and requests queued by API Priority and Fairness.

panels.title: Control-plane pods
panels.description: Static control-plane pods and the cloud-controller-manager: ready state and restarts. Restarts of kube-controller-manager / kube-scheduler usually mean lost leader-election leases on an overloaded control plane.

panels.title: Control-plane CPU
panels.description: CPU used by the control-plane components. A two-core control plane pegged here is what makes controllers lose their leases.

panels.title: Node network
panels.description: Bytes received (above) and transmitted (below) per node on physical/cloud interfaces.

panels.title: Top namespaces by traffic
panels.description: Pod network receive + transmit per namespace (top 10).

panels.title: Node memory pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time tasks on each node were stalled waiting for memory (pressure stall information). Sustained values mean the node is really short of memory, not just of requests.

title: Kubernetes / Cluster Overview
